items: Tractable: polynomial waqt mein hal-pazeer, to waqt input size ke saath qabil-e-intezam raftar se barhta hai; aise masail 'kaarkardagi se hal-pazeer' hain. Misal: Merge Sort ya Quick Sort se sorting, O(n log n).

Intractable: super-polynomial, aksar exponential, waqt chahiye, to bare inputs ke liye na-qabil-e-amal. Misal: Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP), shehron se guzar kar wapas aane ka sab se chhota raasta; yeh NP-hard hai.

blocks.text: Mumkina raaston ki tadaad factorial ke hisab se barhti hai: n! ka matlab n se 1 tak tamam poore adad ki zarb. 2 shehron ke liye 2! = 2, 3 ke liye 3! = 6, 4 ke liye 4! = 24. Durust taur par, muqarrar shuru ke shehar aur rukh nazar-andaz kar ke (n - 1)!/2 alag chakkar bante hain, magar yeh tadaad bhi factorial ke hisab se barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Tractable aur intractable masail ka muwazna kijiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Dono hal-pazeer hain, magar tractable masail ke polynomial-time algorithms hain jin ka waqt input barhne par qabil-e-intezam rehta hai (sorting), jabke intractable masail ko super-polynomial waqt chahiye, to bare inputs par durust hal na-mumkin sa ho jata hai (bohat se shehron wala TSP).

items: Tractable: polynomial waqt (merge sort O(n log n)). Intractable: super-polynomial (TSP, raaste n! ki tarah barhte hain).
